## Selected projects

- AI Sales Calling Agent (Python / OpenAI APIs / Twilio / Retell AI): Independently developed an AI sales calling agent that completed 1,000+ calls, automating calling work previously handled by a three-person sales calling team.
- AI Video Chatbot (Python / Next.js / MongoDB): Independently built an AI video chatbot end to end that acts as a company representative and guides users through a Ready for Next (RFN) form.
- News Scraping (Playwright / OpenAI): Independently built a client news portal tool end to end, collecting news from 64+ providers without APIs or RSS feeds using Playwright and OpenAI.
- WhatsApp Chatbot & Campaign Tools (Next.js / Python / MySQL / Meta WhatsApp APIs): Built internal WhatsApp chatbot and campaign tools, and set up a separate internal campaign automation tool.
- Email Automation & Validation (Amazon SES / Multiple SMTP providers): Independently developed email automation with campaign scheduling and sender configuration, sending 100,000+ emails cumulatively. Built a separate bulk email validation tool that reduced campaign spam rate by approximately 80%.
- Lead Collection Automation (Python / Excel): Independently developed tools that read Excel inputs, collect contact details from websites, and export results to Excel, reducing manual collection work.
- Schic (WooCommerce / AWS): Independently rebuilt and migrated an ecommerce platform with 1,000+ products and 90,000+ customer records. Built the replacement alongside the live site and switched over in approximately one month. Hosted on AWS with auto scaling.
- GoPit (PHP / Flutter / Python): Managed Flutter mobile app development by another developer. Independently built the remaining search engine components: the PHP website, Python scraping, search provider APIs, Skyscanner integration, and Leaflet maps.
- LeaseLark (Next.js / PHP / Python / MySQL): Managed the project end to end, covering client interaction, requirements gathering, scope preparation, task allocation, integration, and deployment.
- Visio Square (PHP / MySQL / Razorpay / FedEx): Independently built a contact lens store end to end, with patient-to-manufacturer ordering, Razorpay payments, and FedEx shipping integration.
